name: io.github.NemoNobody/velruna
title: Velruna
description: Verified-fact memory for AI agents: facts with source, date and edit history on OpenSearch.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSEARCH_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenSearch endpoint the server reads and writes (velruna does not embed a store).

environmentVariables.name: OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: OpenSearch password (kept in the client's secret store, never in the image).

environmentVariables.name: VELRUNA_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow a plain http:// endpoint during development.
